senses.definition: n.[m.] produce, outgrowth (abbrev. or scribal error for foregoing)—only sg. cstr. ב׳ הָרִים Jb 40:20; also ב׳ עֵץ Is 44:19 the produce of a tree, i.e. a block of wood.
